failure_summary.description: A cached result for a named attraction was treated as satisfying a newly accepted request to explore attractions of a specific type.
The hotel search omitted the supported traveler count for a solo trip and did not bind or save the search result.

patch.reasoning: The skill already requires saving tool results and using a supported traveler-count field for solo travel, so those rules do not need repeating. Clarifying how to interpret short affirmative replies closes the remaining ambiguity: resolve the accepted offer before checking cache coverage, then verify that cached criteria cover the resulting request.

edits.content: - Resolve short affirmative replies (such as “yes” or “that sounds great”) against the immediately preceding assistant question or offer before checking cache coverage. Treat an accepted new domain, category, or preference as part of the current request; reuse cached results only when their recorded criteria explicitly satisfy it.
